paper.title: Testing For Distribution Shifts with Conditional Conformal Test Martingales

claims.scope: Released synthetic shift suites and fixed-reference mechanism control; ImageNet-C excluded.
Theorem 3.1 universal any-null-distribution statement; an assumption-matched Dirac-null witness crosses the rejection threshold.
Corrected Theorem 3.3 proof obligations with 952 rational checks and independent validation; not proof-assistant formalization.
Corrected DKW versus no-DKW synthetic control.
Released synthetic immediate, delayed, and gradual shift suites with null controls.
Full ImageNet-C Figure 4 protocol is blocked by missing entropy arrays and raw tables.

non_claims: No complete ImageNet-C reproduction is claimed.
Historical judge scores and projections are provenance, not a current score.
Finite simulations are not presented as proofs of universal or asymptotic theorems.
